Why 1,000+ Institutions Trust OpenEduCat

Education leaders need a platform that grows with their institution, keeps data secure, and doesn't lock them into a single vendor. OpenEduCat delivers enterprise capabilities at a price that makes sense.

Your Data, Your Control

Choose cloud hosting for simplicity or on-premise for complete data sovereignty. Either way, your institution owns its data. No vendor lock-in, ever.

Compliance-Ready from Day One

FERPA-aligned data handling, complete audit trails, and enterprise-grade security. Pass your next compliance review with confidence.

Connects to Everything

Integrates with your existing student systems, payment platforms, communication tools, and campus infrastructure. No rip-and-replace required.

Budget-Friendly at Any Scale

Fixed pricing that doesn't penalize you for growing enrollment. No per-student fees. No surprise invoices. Budget with confidence.
